message: Autoresearch goal created: Implement and validate Apple-Silicon-native Mojo operator backends in a maintained fork of facebookresearch/pytorch3d, colocated with and parallel to PyTorch3D's existing CPU/CUDA implementations, then make ARIA-NBV PR #23 consume that fork so VIN-store generation, multi-step rollout-dataset generation, rendering, and pose generation run end-to-end natively on this Mac with minimal ARIA-side code.
